notes: The verse writes both arms of rule 20: tois pathemasin has no possessor token and its article takes my, while te sarki mou does and its article is empty.
on my part (t013-t015) realizes the ant- preverb of antanapleroo and stays inside s009's unit under rule 106, which forbids marking such a realization added.
s010/s011 follow rule 92: the article keeps the determiner that and the noun carries the supplied relativizer and copula of which is lacking.
s021 is emptied because the English possessor body's occupies the determiner slot, his belonging to autou (rules 20, 57).
